data.name: Rayyana
data.long_meaning: Rayyana is an Arabic Islamic name for girls, which means luxurious, rich. This name is derived from the word 'Rayyan', which means 'well watered' or 'abundant', and is also the name of one of the gates of paradise.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing abundance, prosperity and blessings from Allah.
